test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

When will the results of the dance competition be announced?

options.text: When will they are announcing the results of the dance competition?
When will they announce the results of the dance competition?
When will they announced the results of the dance competition?
Will they announce the results of the dance competition?

solution:
The correct answer is: **When will they announce the results of the dance competition?**
